name: Python project layout (src + monorepo next to Next/Axum)
short_definition: Canonical 2026 layout for Python services and libraries: src-layout packages managed by uv, optionally as workspace members, coexisting in a polyglot monorepo beside Next.js (apps/web) and Axum/Rust (services/* or crates/*) without shared import roots or accidental CWD imports.
scope_in: src vs flat layout choice; uv init package vs app; single-package service tree; uv workspaces vs path deps; monorepo folder conventions next to TS/Rust; py.typed; tests placement; import package naming; editable installs via uv sync; boundary of what lives under services/python vs packages/.
scope_out: Poetry/PDM layouts; notebook-first project trees; Django project template specifics; conda envs; language choice (Python vs TS vs Rust); dependency version policy (see py-uv-packaging / py-versions-and-runtime); pre-commit wiring (see py-prek-hooks).
defaults: Greenfield library or deployable service: always src layout via `uv init --package` (or --lib). Import package under `src/<import_name>/` with `py.typed`. Tests outside package at `tests/` (not under src). Single root `pyproject.toml` + committed `uv.lock` + `.python-version`. Polyglot monorepo default: place Python under `services/<name>/` or `packages/<name>/` as peer of `apps/web` (Next) and `services/api-rust` / `crates/` — do not nest Python under `apps/`. Multi-package Python: use `tool.uv.workspace` with members globs (`packages/*`, `services/py-*`) and one shared lock at workspace root when deps are compatible; use path deps (not workspace) when members need separate requires-python or conflicting resolutions. Prefer package names that match import names (hyphen distro → underscore import). Run via `uv run` / entry points, never `python src/...` path hacks in prod.
decision_gates: USE src layout: any library, any CI-tested service, anything agents scaffold, anything shared across workers. USE flat only: throwaway scripts and one-file CLIs you will not publish (still prefer src if tests exist). USE uv workspace: multiple interdependent Python packages with shared resolution and one lock. USE path deps instead of workspace: members conflict on requires-python or need isolated venvs. USE separate top-level service dir (not workspace member of JS root): when only one Python service sits beside Next — give it its own pyproject + lock; optional path dep on a shared `packages/py-common`. DO NOT put import packages at monorepo root next to package.json. DO NOT share one giant src/ across languages.
do_dont: DO: `uv init --package my_service` for services; commit uv.lock; add empty `src/<pkg>/py.typed`; put tests in `tests/` mirroring package; use `tool.uv.sources` with `workspace = true` for intra-workspace deps; document monorepo map in README (apps/web, services/py-api, crates/api). DO: keep OpenAPI/schema contracts at repo `contracts/` or package boundary, not deep inside src. DON'T: flat `my_package/` beside pyproject for greenfield. DON'T: put tests inside import package unless package is a test harness. DON'T: rely on CWD imports or PYTHONPATH hacks. DON'T: one workspace spanning Node and Python tooling. DON'T: mix setup.py + poetry.lock with uv greenfield. DON'T: name distro `api` if import collides with stdlib-adjacent names — prefer `acme_api`.
code_skeleton:
# monorepo (polyglot)
# apps/web/                 # Next.js BFF/UI
# services/api-rust/        # Axum
# services/py-worker/       # Python service (own project)
# packages/py-common/       # optional shared Python lib (src layout)
# contracts/openapi.yaml
#
# services/py-worker/pyproject.toml
[project]
name = "py-worker"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
  "fastapi>=0.115",
  "uvicorn[standard]>=0.32",
  "py-common",
]

[project.scripts]
py-worker = "py_worker.main:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.11.28,<0.12"]
build-backend = "uv_build"

[tool.uv.sources]
py-common = { path = "../../packages/py-common", editable = true }

# packages/py-common/src/py_common/__init__.py + py.typed
# services/py-worker/src/py_worker/main.py
# services/py-worker/tests/test_health.py
#
# Workspace alternative (Python-only subtree root):
# [tool.uv.workspace]
# members = ["packages/*", "services/py-*"]
# exclude = ["packages/legacy"]
failure_modes: 1) Flat layout + `pytest` from repo root imports undeployed source while CI install omits modules → green local, red/prod missing files. 2) Import package at monorepo root shadows installed wheel and breaks editable/CI parity. 3) Workspace members with conflicting requires-python → silent intersection / resolution failures. 4) Path deps without editable in multi-package dev → stale imports after edits. 5) Nested pyproject without clear ownership → two locks drift. 6) Running `python main.py` from src tree bypasses package install and entrypoints. 7) Colliding package names across services (both `src/api`) confuse agents and imports.
anti_patterns: Agents must not: scaffold flat layout for new services; invent `src/python` without pyproject; colocate notebooks as product modules under src; put Next app routes inside Python package; hand-sync duplicate packages in apps/ and services/; use setup.py as primary config; leave out py.typed on typed libraries; use namespace package hacks without need; PYTHONPATH=. in Docker/CMD; monorepo root as single import root for all languages.
tools: Primary: uv (init/sync/run/workspace), uv_build or hatchling build backend, ruff, basedpyright/ty, pytest. Alternatives: hatchling/setuptools backends; path deps instead of workspace; Pants/Bazel only if org already mandates (not greenfield default).
versions_as_of: as_of 2026-07-13: uv 0.11.28 (PyPI latest; local brew may lag e.g. 0.11.23); Python pin policy 3.12–3.14 via .python-version (prefer 3.12 LTS-ish service pin unless team standardizes higher); ruff 0.15.x; packaging guidance per PyPA src-layout discussion (current). uv workspace docs examples use uv_build>=0.11.28,<0.12.
config_snippets:
# Root or service pyproject essentials
[project]
name = "acme-worker"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = []

[build-system]
requires = ["uv_build>=0.11.28,<0.12"]
build-backend = "uv_build"

[tool.ruff]
src = ["src"]
target-version = "py312"

[tool.basedpyright]
include = ["src", "tests"]
extraPaths = []  # prefer installed package, not raw src hacks

# - test: uv sync --frozen && uv run pytest
# - fail if importable package sits at repo root without src/
deprecation_watch: Poetry-first monorepo layouts; setup.py-only projects; pip-tools dual requirements without uv.lock; flat layout as default in agent templates; putting Python under `app/` Next convention; tox.ini-era src hacks without package install; multiple competing lockfiles (poetry.lock + uv.lock) in one package.
ts_boundary: Next/TS owns UI + BFF Server Actions. Python lives in `services/*` as peer, not under `apps/web`. Shared contracts: OpenAPI/JSON Schema under `contracts/` or generated into `packages/types` for TS — never import Python packages from TS. Align folder naming with typescript.md monorepo pattern (apps/, packages/, services/).
rust_boundary: Rust (Axum) for high-throughput APIs/gateways per rust.md. Prefer separate `services/api-rust` or `crates/` tree. Hand off to Rust when latency/CPU critical; keep Python for AI/ML pipelines, orchestration, data jobs. Do not merge Rust crate layout into Python src/. Shared contract via OpenAPI/protobuf, not FFI in default stack.
supabase_boundary: Python services talk to Postgres via SQLAlchemy/asyncpg or supabase-py with service role only on server. Migrations ownership: one owner per table (Supabase/TS or Python or Rust) — document in layout README. Keep DB client modules under `src/<pkg>/db/`, not at monorepo root.
boundary_contracts: OpenAPI YAML/JSON in `contracts/`; env vars via pydantic-settings in service package; migrations colocated with owner service; MCP tool servers as separate packages under services/ with isolated deps. CI generates TS types from OpenAPI — no hand-synced DTOs.
decision_matrix_row: Problem: greenfield Python library/service structure → Python src layout + uv. Problem: monorepo with Next UI + Python worker → polyglot folders (apps/web + services/py-*), path or workspace for Python only. Problem: shared domain types across TS and Python → contract-first OpenAPI/JSON Schema, not shared runtime package. Problem: hot path HTTP → prefer Rust Axum service, not packing more into Python src. Problem: CRUD BFF only → stay TypeScript, no new Python package.
threats: Accidental execution of uninstalled/editable-wrong tree (local-only modules missing in image); path dependency confusion in monorepos; shipping tests or scripts as importable attack surface; writable monorepo roots on PATH in containers; secrets in layout (`.env` under src committed).
mitigations: src layout + frozen sync in CI/Docker; non-root images; .dockerignore excluding tests/secrets; single lockfile discipline; no secrets under src/; explicit package install in multi-stage builds; review path/workspace sources in PRs.
agent_codegen_policy: MUST generate: src/<pkg>/, py.typed for libs, tests/, pyproject with build-system, .python-version, uv.lock after deps. MUST place Python under services/ or packages/ in polyglot repos. MUST NOT: flat import package at root; notebook modules as product; PYTHONPATH hacks; setup.py primary; nest under apps/web; invent dual package managers.
tests_required: Import smoke: `uv run python -c "import <pkg>"` after clean sync. Unit tests from installed package (not CWD). Optional: packaging check that wheel contains expected modules only. Layout regression: fail if package directory exists outside src for libraries.
ci_gates: uv sync --frozen; ruff; basedpyright; pytest; optional `uv build` + install wheel in clean venv smoke. Block PRs that add top-level import packages without src/.
skill_scan_signals: POSITIVE: `src/<pkg>/`, `py.typed`, `uv.lock`, `tool.uv.workspace` or clear single service pyproject, tests/ outside src, services/py-* next to apps/web. NEGATIVE: flat `mypkg/` beside pyproject for new code; `PYTHONPATH=src`; poetry.lock+uv.lock dual; notebooks under src; package named `test`/`src`; missing build-system; import from repo root scripts only.
skill_module_bullets:
- Default Python layout: src package via uv init --package; tests/ outside src; py.typed on libraries.
- Polyglot monorepo: apps/web (Next), services/*-rust (Axum), services/py-* or packages/py-* (Python) — never nest Python under Next app.
- Multi-package Python: uv workspace + one lock when compatible; else path editable deps.
- Run with uv run / entry points; no CWD import reliance.
- Contracts (OpenAPI) live at repo boundary; generate TS types — don't share Python modules with TS.
action_items: 1) Codify monorepo tree in references/python.md. 2) Agent scaffold template: uv init --package under services/. 3) Scan rules for flat layout and missing py.typed. 4) Document workspace vs path-dep decision. 5) Example repo skeleton in skill templates.
checklist:
[ ] src/<import_pkg>/ with intentional name
[ ] py.typed if library or typed service package
[ ] tests/ outside package
[ ] pyproject.toml + uv.lock + .python-version committed
[ ] build-system declared
[ ] No import package at monorepo root
[ ] Peer placement vs apps/web and Rust services documented

[ ] Entry point or module -m works without PYTHONPATH

conflicts_noted: uv init default app is flat (main.py); packaging consensus and Hynek/production guidance prefer src — greenfield policy forces --package/--lib. Workspace vs path deps: Astral docs say workspace not for conflicting requirements; some monorepos still prefer per-service lock always — both valid; prefer workspace only when resolution shared.
